Holding(s) in Company

Summary by AI BETAClose X

HSBC Holdings plc has reported a change in its notification of major holdings in Informa PLC, with its total voting rights and financial instruments now standing at 6.123%, representing 76,996,454 voting rights. This change, which occurred on August 19, 2026, saw the percentage of voting rights attached to shares increase to 6.011% and voting rights through financial instruments decrease slightly to 0.112%. The previous notification indicated a total of 6.054%.
